name: Meditation Plane
description: Bolas's plane where Vraska met him and where Jace's spell failed.

timeline.summary: Caleria is defeated in the duel and lets the group leave; Tetsuo and Ayesha kill the insect inside Kei, halting his mutation.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo and Ayesha engage the insect inside Kei on the Meditation plane and kill it.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo hides on the Meditation Plane while Wasitora's kittens destroy a kentsu regiment sent to Sekana.
timeline.quote: The regiment was destroyed by Wasitora's kittens

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Champion against emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo flees to the Meditation Plane and destroys the Imperial Shrine with Meteor Hammer; denied his planeswalker powers, Bolas is defeated.
timeline.quote: Denied his powers as a planeswalker, Bolas was defeated by Tetsuo.

citation.text: "Tetsuo Umezawa", section "Champion against emperor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo draws Bolas to the Meditation Plane, destroys the shrine with Hage's hammer, and kills Bolas.
timeline.quote: and Tetsuo kills him

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds an enchanted invitation from a dragon in her book and planeswalks to the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: she planeswalked through a dark slice in the air.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
timeline.quote: I accept your terms,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
timeline.quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers to make Vraska guildmaster of the Golgari if she retrieves an item from Orazca on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas offered to make her the guildmaster of the Golgari

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Nicol Bolas on the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas was waiting for her.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas scours Vraska's mind and replays her Ixalan memories.
timeline.quote: He peered into each corner of her memories of Ixalan and replayed them all in the blink of an eye.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
timeline.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas rewards Vraska with a kingdom of her own design.
timeline.quote: You have earned a kingdom of your own design.

citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas kills Ugin for the first time on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas kills Ugin for the first time.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Time of Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin and Bolas fight for days, years and generations before returning to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas kills Ugin; the resulting waves fling Bolas to Madara.
timeline.quote: where Bolas killed Ugin

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Confrontation of the twins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The wrecked plane restores itself, and Ugin is reborn from its waters.
timeline.quote: The dragon was reborn and floated above a once again dry seabed beneath the luminous sky.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Confrontation of the twins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas makes the realm his seat, raising two gigantic horns from the waters.
timeline.quote: he erected two gigantic curved horns so they emerged from the waters

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "The seat of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo flees into the realm, reveals his plan and cleaves Bolas's spirit in half before escaping to Madara as the realm's boundaries collapse.
timeline.quote: The champion cleaved the elder dragon's spirit in half and narrowly escaped to Madara

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Madaran refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, the Meditation Plane becomes a pocket plane; Sarkhan visits and is debriefed by Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Meditation Plane became a pocket plane of its own, separate from Dominaria

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas offers Vraska leadership over the Golgari if she finds the Immortal Sun on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Bolas offered her leadership over the Golgari if she traveled to Ixalan

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Bolas's faked death, Ugin secretly takes the mortal Bolas to the realm, reveals the Spirit-Gem and strips him of both names.
timeline.quote: Ugin then took away both of Bolas's names and rendered the fallen one nameless.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin declares himself Bolas's jailer for eternity and spreads himself over the realm, making it a prison for both.
timeline.quote: The Realm thus became an eternal prison for Bolas and Ugin alike.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the realm the group meets the two sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless Bolas seeks a chance to regain power.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and casts a spell to reshape the realm; unable to sustain it, he shatters like glass as reality unmakes.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: All present, including Bolas, flee the realm; later it reforms with the reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak.
timeline.quote: a reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak manifested in its waters

citation.text: "Meditation Plane", section "Jace's spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Having allied with Ugin, Niv-Mizzet had made a device to preserve his spirit, which Sarkhan Vol delivers to the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Having allied with Ugin , Niv-Mizzet created a device to preserve his spirit after death.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas is defeated and Ugin imprisons him on the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas is defeated and thought dead by all but Jace Beleren , while Ugin in reality imprisons him on the Meditation Plane .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the Meditation Plane Ugin lets Bolas fatally wound him, shattering the plane and casting Bolas into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Ugin returned to the Meditation Realm and allowed his brother to fatally wound him.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin is reborn as a Spirit Dragon in a body formed from the Realm's waters.
timeline.quote: Ugin awakened, his spirit inhabiting a new body formed from the Meditation Realm's waters.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Confrontation on the Meditation Plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin conspires with Sarkhan, retakes the Meditation Realm and gains a way to spy through the Spirit-Gem on Bolas.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan helped Ugin bypass the wards that Bolas used to protect the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin takes Bolas's body to the Meditation Realm and has Jace conceal it with an illusion.
timeline.quote: Ugin took his brother's body to the Meditation Realm to prevent him from coming back to life on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas wakes powerless and nameless; Ugin merges his essence with the sealed Meditation Realm to watch him until his natural death.
timeline.quote: He'd also sealed the plane off from the rest of the multiverse

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The End". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas escapes into the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas escapes into the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace reforms as the custodian of the Meditation Realm, mind fractured into aspects.
timeline.quote: Jace reforms as the custodian of the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Theorist rises above Jace's other aspects.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the Theorist stands ascendant over them all.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Omenpath Era (4562 AR - present)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Vraska, Narset and Elspeth reach the Meditation Realm and meet Ugin and the nameless Bolas.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace steals the Spirit-Gem and casts a reality-bending spell that fails and unmakes him.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Rediscovered". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's spell in the Meditation Plane fails and unmakes reality including Jace; Narset picks up Loot as the survivors escape, and he is returned to the grieving Vraska on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: The distressed Loot was picked up by Narset right before the survivors escaped.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Interplanar travels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's spell to remake the Multiverse fails and he is unmade.
timeline.quote: Jace cast his spell anyway, and she watched in horror as it failed

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Pursuing the plan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace rebuilds himself and begins constructing a new reality.
timeline.quote: He began constructing a new reality

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Theorist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren tries to reimagine the Multiverse so the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Desparkening and the Omenpaths never happened.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren tried to reimagine the Multiverse into a form where the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reach the Meditation Plane via an ancient Omenpath, meet Narset and Elspeth, and are confronted by the two sealed elder dragons.
timeline.quote: To their shock, they were met by the two elder dragons that had been sealed away here in eternal lockdown.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "To the Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin berates Jace for breaking their agreement and warns them away, while Bolas sees a chance to gain information and power.
timeline.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "To the Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: While the others are distracted, Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem and begins casting his spell.
timeline.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem .

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Casting the spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth attacks Bolas to distract him and Vraska tries to hold Jace back, but he proceeds.
timeline.quote: Thinking that he would offer the Gem to Bolas, Elspeth attacked and temporarily distracted him.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Casting the spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's spell fails because he is only human; the horizon shatters, a void unmakes reality and Jace shatters like glass.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Casting the spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A reflected silhouette of a mage in a blue cloak manifests in the Realm's waters and begins constructing a new reality.
timeline.quote: He began constructing a new reality, painstakingly calculating and recalculating the variables necessary.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Aftermath of the spell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska enter the Meditation Plane through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska traveled through an Omenpath to the Meditation Plane

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace steals Ugin's Spirit-Gem.
timeline.quote: he secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole his Spirit-Gem

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace's attempt fails and he shatters like glass.
timeline.quote: he shattered like glass

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Everyone, including Bolas, flees the Meditation Realm.
timeline.quote: all present, including Bolas, left the Meditation Realm

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Meditation Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Meditation Plane they met Jace and Loot, and found Ugin and the nameless dragon who had been Nicol Bolas; Elspeth inadvertently revealed his name.
timeline.quote: she inadvertently revealed his name to him

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace stole Ugin's Spirit-Gem and cast a spell to undo the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Jace stole Ugin's Spirit-Gem and began casting a complex spell

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The spell collapsed, erasing everything in its path, including Jace, who shattered like glass.
timeline.quote: including Jace, who shattered like glass

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas overpowered Ugin and escaped into the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Bolas overpowered Ugin and escaped into the Multiverse.

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A reflected silhouette of a blue-cloaked mage appeared, a sign Jace had reformed as the plane's custodian.
timeline.quote: a sign that Jace had reformed as the plane's custodian

citation.text: "Meditation Plane Breach", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
